audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra vows, valuations, dedications, and tithe text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for vow valuations by age/sex, poverty adjustment, animals, houses, fields, Jubilee calculation, redemption plus fifth, firstborn, devoted things, and tithe. Strong anti-human-worth-ranking and anti-coercion safeguards required.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel and say to them: When a person makes a special vow involving valuation of persons to YHWH,

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.

modern.text: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them, ‘When someone makes a special vow to the LORD involving the value of persons,

original.text: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יַפְלִ֖א נֶ֑דֶר בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ נְפָשֹׁ֖ת לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: your valuation for a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to sanctuary shekel.

familiar.text: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

modern.text: if the valuation concerns a male from twenty to sixty years of age, then your valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel.

original.text: וְהָיָ֤ה עֶרְכְּךָ֙ הַזָּכָ֔ר מִבֶּן֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וְהָיָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֗ חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כֶּ֖סֶף בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: If female, your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

familiar.text: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

modern.text: Or if it is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

original.text: וְאִם נְקֵבָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְהָיָ֥ה עֶרְכְּךָ֖ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָֽׁקֶל

verses.restored: If from five years old to twenty years old, your valuation for male shall be twenty shekels, and for female ten shekels.

familiar.text: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

modern.text: And if the person is from five to twenty years of age, then your valuation for the male shall be twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

original.text: וְאִ֨ם מִבֶּן חָמֵ֜שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים וְעַד֙ בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְהָיָ֧ה עֶרְכְּךָ֛ הַזָּכָ֖ר עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֑ים וְלַנְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת שְׁקָלִֽים

verses.restored: If from one month old to five years old, your valuation for male shall be five shekels of silver, and for female your valuation three shekels of silver.

familiar.text: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.

modern.text: Now if the person is from one month to five years of age, then your valuation for the male shall be five shekels of silver, and for the female three shekels of silver.

original.text: וְאִ֣ם מִבֶּן חֹ֗דֶשׁ וְעַד֙ בֶּן חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְהָיָ֤ה עֶרְכְּךָ֙ הַזָּכָ֔ר חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּ֑סֶף וְלַנְּקֵבָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֔ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּֽסֶף

verses.restored: If from sixty years old and upward, if male your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for female ten shekels.

familiar.text: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

modern.text: And if the person is sixty years of age or older, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels for the male and ten shekels for the female.

original.text: וְ֠אִם מִבֶּן שִׁשִּׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה וָמַ֨עְלָה֙ אִם זָכָ֔ר וְהָיָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֔ חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר שָׁ֑קֶל וְלַנְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֥ה שְׁקָלִֽים

verses.restored: But if he is too poor for your valuation, he shall be stood before priest, and priest shall value him; according to what hand of one vowing can reach, priest shall value him.

familiar.text: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.

modern.text: But if the one making the vow is too poor to pay the valuation, he is to present the person before the priest, who shall set the value according to what the one making the vow can afford.

original.text: וְאִם מָ֥ךְ הוּא֙ מֵֽעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְהֶֽעֱמִידוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהֶעֱרִ֥יךְ אֹת֖וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן עַל פִּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּשִּׂיג֙ יַ֣ד הַנֹּדֵ֔ר יַעֲרִיכֶ֖נּוּ הַכֹּהֵֽן

verses.restored: If it is beast from which they bring near offering to YHWH, all that one gives from it to YHWH shall be holy.

familiar.text: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.

modern.text: If he vows an animal that may be brought as an offering to the LORD, any such animal given to the LORD shall be holy.

original.text: וְאִם בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛נָּה קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מִמֶּ֛נּוּ לַיהוָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה קֹּֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: He shall not replace it nor exchange it, good for bad or bad for good; and if exchanging, he exchanges beast for beast, both it and its exchange shall be holy.

familiar.text: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

modern.text: He must not replace it or exchange it, either good for bad or bad for good. But if he does substitute one animal for another, both that animal and its substitute will be holy.

original.text: לֹ֣א יַחֲלִיפֶ֗נּוּ וְלֹֽא יָמִ֥יר אֹת֛וֹ ט֥וֹב בְּרָ֖ע אוֹ רַ֣ע בְּט֑וֹב וְאִם הָמֵ֨ר יָמִ֤יר בְּהֵמָה֙ בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה וְהָֽיָה ה֥וּא וּתְמוּרָת֖וֹ יִֽהְיֶה קֹּֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: If it is any unclean beast from which they do not bring near offering to YHWH, he shall stand beast before priest.

familiar.text: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:

modern.text: But if the vow involves any of the unclean animals that may not be brought as an offering to the LORD, the animal must be presented before the priest.

original.text: וְאִם֙ כָּל בְּהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֔ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛נָּה קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְהֶֽעֱמִ֥יד אֶת הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הַכֹּהֵֽן

verses.restored: Priest shall value it, whether good or bad; according to your valuation, priest, so it shall be.

familiar.text: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.

modern.text: The priest shall set its value, whether high or low; as the priest values it, the price will be set.

original.text: וְהֶעֱרִ֤יךְ הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֹתָ֔הּ בֵּ֥ין ט֖וֹב וּבֵ֣ין רָ֑ע כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יִהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: If redeeming, he redeems it, he shall add its fifth upon your valuation.

familiar.text: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.

modern.text: If, however, the owner decides to redeem the animal, he must add a fifth to its value.

original.text: וְאִם גָּאֹ֖ל יִגְאָלֶ֑נָּה וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִישִׁת֖וֹ עַל עֶרְכֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: When a man sanctifies his house as holy to YHWH, priest shall value it, whether good or bad; as priest values it, so it shall stand.

familiar.text: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

modern.text: Now if a man consecrates his house as holy to the LORD, then the priest shall value it either as good or bad. The price will stand just as the priest values it.

original.text: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי יַקְדִּ֨שׁ אֶת בֵּית֥וֹ קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְהֶעֱרִיכוֹ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן בֵּ֥ין ט֖וֹב וּבֵ֣ין רָ֑ע כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲרִ֥יךְ אֹת֛וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יָקֽוּם

verses.restored: If one who sanctified it redeems his house, he shall add fifth of silver of your valuation upon it, and it shall be his.

familiar.text: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.

modern.text: But if he who consecrated his house redeems it, he must add a fifth to the assessed value, and it will belong to him.

original.text: וְאִ֨ם הַמַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ יִגְאַ֖ל אֶת בֵּית֑וֹ וְ֠יָסַף חֲמִישִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף עֶרְכְּךָ֛ עָלָ֖יו וְהָ֥יָה לֽוֹ

verses.restored: If from field of his possession a man sanctifies to YHWH, your valuation shall be according to its seed: seed of homer of barley at fifty shekels of silver.

familiar.text: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

modern.text: If a man consecrates to the LORD a parcel of his land, then your valuation shall be proportional to the seed required for it—fifty shekels of silver for every homer of barley seed.

original.text: וְאִ֣ם מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֗וֹ יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה עֶרְכְּךָ֖ לְפִ֣י זַרְע֑וֹ זֶ֚רַע חֹ֣מֶר שְׂעֹרִ֔ים בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כָּֽסֶף

verses.restored: If from year of Jubilee he sanctifies his field, according to your valuation it shall stand.

familiar.text: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.

modern.text: If he consecrates his field during the Year of Jubilee, the price will stand according to your valuation.

original.text: אִם מִשְּׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵ֑הוּ כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֖ יָקֽוּם

verses.restored: But if after Jubilee he sanctifies his field, priest shall calculate silver for him according to years remaining until year of Jubilee, and it shall be reduced from your valuation.

familiar.text: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.

modern.text: But if he consecrates his field after the Jubilee, the priest is to calculate the price in proportion to the years left until the next Year of Jubilee, so that your valuation will be reduced.

original.text: וְאִם אַחַ֣ר הַיֹּבֵל֮ יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ֒ וְחִשַּׁב ל֨וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת הַכֶּ֗סֶף עַל פִּ֤י הַשָּׁנִים֙ הַנּ֣וֹתָרֹ֔ת עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנִגְרַ֖ע מֵֽעֶרְכֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: If redeeming, one who sanctified field redeems it, he shall add fifth of silver of your valuation upon it, and it shall stand to him.

familiar.text: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.

modern.text: And if the one who consecrated the field decides to redeem it, he must add a fifth to the assessed value, and it shall belong to him.

original.text: וְאִם גָּאֹ֤ל יִגְאַל֙ אֶת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה הַמַּקְדִּ֖ישׁ אֹת֑וֹ וְ֠יָסַף חֲמִשִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף עֶרְכְּךָ֛ עָלָ֖יו וְקָ֥ם לֽוֹ

verses.restored: But if he does not redeem field, or if he sold field to another man, it shall not be redeemed again.

familiar.text: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.

modern.text: If, however, he does not redeem the field, or if he has sold it to another man, it may no longer be redeemed.

original.text: וְאִם לֹ֤א יִגְאַל֙ אֶת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וְאִם מָכַ֥ר אֶת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה לְאִ֣ישׁ אַחֵ֑ר לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל עֽוֹד

verses.restored: The field, when it goes out in Jubilee, shall be holy to YHWH as devoted field; its possession shall belong to priest.

familiar.text: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.

modern.text: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the LORD; it becomes the property of the priests.

original.text: וְהָיָ֨ה הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה בְּצֵאת֣וֹ בַיֹּבֵ֗ל קֹ֛דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָ֖ה כִּשְׂדֵ֣ה הַחֵ֑רֶם לַכֹּהֵ֖ן תִּהְיֶ֥ה אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ

verses.restored: If field of his purchase, which is not from field of his possession, he sanctifies to YHWH,

familiar.text: And if a man sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;

modern.text: Now if a man consecrates to the LORD a field he has purchased, which is not a part of his own property,

original.text: וְאִם֙ אֶת שְׂדֵ֣ה מִקְנָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֕ר לֹ֖א מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֑וֹ יַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: priest shall calculate for him amount of your valuation until year of Jubilee, and he shall give your valuation on that day as holy to YHWH.

familiar.text: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD.

modern.text: then the priest shall calculate for him the value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the man shall pay the assessed value on that day as a sacred offering to the LORD.

original.text: וְחִשַּׁב ל֣וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֵ֚ת מִכְסַ֣ת הָֽעֶרְכְּךָ֔ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנָתַ֤ן אֶת הָעֶרְכְּךָ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: In year of Jubilee field shall return to one from whom he bought it, to one whose possession of land it was.

familiar.text: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.

modern.text: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom it was bought—the original owner of the land.

original.text: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת הַיּוֹבֵל֙ יָשׁ֣וּב הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר קָנָ֖הוּ מֵאִתּ֑וֹ לַאֲשֶׁר ל֖וֹ אֲחֻזַּ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Every valuation of yours shall be according to sanctuary shekel; twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

familiar.text: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

modern.text: Every valuation will be according to the sanctuary shekel, twenty gerahs to the shekel.

original.text: וְכָל עֶרְכְּךָ֔ יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה הַשָּֽׁקֶל

verses.restored: Only firstborn among beasts, which is firstborn to YHWH, no man shall sanctify it; whether ox or sheep, it belongs to YHWH.

familiar.text: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD’s firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the LORD’s.

modern.text: But no one may consecrate a firstborn of the livestock, because a firstborn belongs to the LORD. Whether it is an ox or a sheep, it is the LORD’s.

original.text: אַךְ בְּכ֞וֹר אֲשֶׁר יְבֻכַּ֤ר לַֽיהוָה֙ בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה לֹֽא יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ אֹת֑וֹ אִם שׁ֣וֹר אִם שֶׂ֔ה לַֽיהוָ֖ה הֽוּא

verses.restored: If among unclean beasts, he may redeem according to your valuation and add its fifth upon it; if it is not redeemed, it shall be sold according to your valuation.

familiar.text: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.

modern.text: But if it is among the unclean animals, then he may redeem it according to your valuation and add a fifth of its value. If it is not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

original.text: וְאִ֨ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֤ה הַטְּמֵאָה֙ וּפָדָ֣ה בְעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִשִׁת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְאִם לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל וְנִמְכַּ֥ר בְּעֶרְכֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: Only any devoted thing that a man devotes to YHWH from all that is his, from human or beast or field of his possession, shall not be sold and shall not be redeemed; every devoted thing is Holy of Holies to YHWH.

familiar.text: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD.

modern.text: Nothing that a man sets apart to the LORD from all he owns—whether a man, an animal, or his inherited land—can be sold or redeemed; everything so devoted is most holy to the LORD.

original.text: אַךְ כָּל חֵ֡רֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַחֲרִם֩ אִ֨ישׁ לַֽיהוָ֜ה מִכָּל אֲשֶׁר ל֗וֹ מֵאָדָ֤ם וּבְהֵמָה֙ וּמִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֔וֹ לֹ֥א יִמָּכֵ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יִגָּאֵ֑ל כָּל חֵ֕רֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Any devoted human who is devoted from humankind shall not be redeemed; surely he shall be put to death.

familiar.text: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.

modern.text: No person set apart for destruction may be ransomed; he must surely be put to death. Instruction on Tithes (Deuteronomy 14:22–29; Deuteronomy 26:1–15; Nehemiah 13:10–14)

original.text: כָּל חֵ֗רֶם אֲשֶׁ֧ר יָחֳרַ֛ם מִן הָאָדָ֖ם לֹ֣א יִפָּדֶ֑ה מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת

verses.restored: Every tithe of land, from seed of land, from fruit of tree, belongs to YHWH; holy it is to YHWH.

familiar.text: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD’s: it is holy unto the LORD.

modern.text: Thus any tithe from the land, whether from the seed of the land or the fruit of the trees, belongs to the LORD; it is holy to the LORD.

original.text: וְכָל מַעְשַׂ֨ר הָאָ֜רֶץ מִזֶּ֤רַע הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ מִפְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ לַיהוָ֖ה ה֑וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: If redeeming, a man redeems from his tithe, he shall add its fifth upon it.

familiar.text: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.

modern.text: If a man wishes to redeem part of his tithe, he must add a fifth to its value.

original.text: וְאִם גָּאֹ֥ל יִגְאַ֛ל אִ֖ישׁ מִמַּֽעַשְׂר֑וֹ חֲמִשִׁית֖וֹ יֹסֵ֥ף עָלָֽיו

verses.restored: Every tithe of herd and flock, all that passes under staff, the tenth shall be holy to YHWH.

familiar.text: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.

modern.text: Every tenth animal from the herd or flock that passes under the shepherd’s rod will be holy to the LORD.

original.text: וְכָל מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָצֹ֔אן כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבֹ֖ר תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑בֶט הָֽעֲשִׂירִ֕י יִֽהְיֶה קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: He shall not inspect whether good or bad and shall not exchange it; if exchanging, he exchanges it, both it and its exchange shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

familiar.text: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

modern.text: He must not inspect whether it is good or bad, and he shall not make any substitution. But if he does make a substitution, both the animal and its substitute shall become holy; they cannot be redeemed.’”

original.text: לֹ֧א יְבַקֵּ֛ר בֵּֽין ט֥וֹב לָרַ֖ע וְלֹ֣א יְמִירֶ֑נּוּ וְאִם הָמֵ֣ר יְמִירֶ֔נּוּ וְהָֽיָה ה֧וּא וּתְמוּרָת֛וֹ יִֽהְיֶה קֹ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵֽל

verses.restored: These are commands that YHWH commanded Moses for children of Israel on Mount Sinai.

familiar.text: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

modern.text: These are the commandments that the LORD gave to Moses for the Israelites on Mount Sinai.

original.text: אֵ֣לֶּה הַמִּצְוֺ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֖ר סִינָֽי

translation_notes: Human valuations in this chapter are vow-payment schedules, not statements of intrinsic human worth, spiritual value, intelligence, dignity, or Divine love.
Verse 8 is crucial: poverty adjusts the valuation according to what the person's hand can reach.
House and field valuations remain tied to Jubilee timing, preventing dedication from erasing the land-return structure of chapter 25.
Redemption commonly adds a fifth, preserving the reparation/redemption pattern used elsewhere in Leviticus.
Verse 29 is severe devoted-person death material and requires deep lexical, legal, and reception-history audit; it must never authorize modern killing, coercive vows, or human sacrifice.
Tithe belongs to YHWH and is treated as holy, while exchange manipulation is blocked.
safety_note: Do not use Leviticus 27 to assign monetary worth to people, rank genders or ages, coerce vows, exploit poverty, justify human sacrifice, or enforce lethal devoted-person rules today. The chapter regulates ancient vow obligations and sacred property; human dignity is not priced by its valuation tables.
